title: Content-Based Restaurant Recommender via User-Item Textual Profiling
description: Developed a personalized recommendation and ranking engine addressing extreme rating skew and implicit feedback nuances using the public SnappFood dataset.
shortDescription: Content-based recommender tackling rating skew and implicit feedback on SnappFood data
highlights: Mitigated severe 5-star rating bias by reframing user preference into a purchase-propensity classification task rather than raw score regression.
Synthesized semantic user/restaurant profiles with TF-IDF representations of review corpora to match latent preferences, ranking candidates via calibrated probabilities.
